text: Objectives Objective of the program in Computer Science and Technology aims to provide students with solid theory as well as the latest technological knowledge. Research methods and communication skills are taught while team works are encouraged. After the program, students should be able to engage in high level research and assume leadership role in their respective fields. Duration Duration of the program is 2-2.5 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Computer Application Techniques 2. Pattern Recognition and Intelligent System 3. Computer Software Theory 4. Information Security Credit Units Students need to successfully complete at least 29 credit units. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship
